phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Science Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore mechanical engineering careers, and develop design skills.

milestones.label: Explore mechanical engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on mechanical engineering applications in automotive, aerospace, energy, HVAC, robotics, and manufacturing.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and integration. Mathematical foundation for mechanics, thermodynamics, and machine design.

milestones.label: Master engineering graphics and SolidWorks
milestones.description: Engineering drawing standards, 3D solid modeling, and CAD using SolidWorks. Students create part models, assemblies, and engineering drawings for mechanical components.

milestones.label: Join ASME student section
milestones.description: Join the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) student section, NSBE, or SWE. Participate in design competitions, 3D printing workshops, and industry events.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, and waves. Foundation for statics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Mechanical Engineering Sciences — Master mechanics, thermodynamics, and materials science.

milestones.label: Master statics
milestones.description: Force equilibrium, free body diagrams, trusses, frames, centroids, and moments of inertia. Foundation for mechanics of materials and machine design.

milestones.label: Study engineering materials science
milestones.description: Crystal structure, phase diagrams, mechanical properties, failure analysis, and material selection. Students test metals, polymers, and composites in the materials lab.

milestones.label: Compete in ASME design competition
milestones.description: Participate in ASME Student Design Competition or Formula SAE preparation. Design, build, and test a mechanical system using engineering analysis and prototyping skills.

milestones.label: Master dynamics
milestones.description: Kinematics and kinetics of particles and rigid bodies, work-energy methods, and vibration analysis. Students analyze mechanical systems in motion.

milestones.label: Master mechanics of materials
milestones.description: Stress, strain, beam deflection, torsion, column buckling, and combined loading. Students analyze structural and machine elements for strength and stiffness.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced ME & Professional Experience — Master thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, machine design, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master thermodynamics
milestones.description: Laws of thermodynamics, power cycles, refrigeration cycles, and combustion. Students analyze engines, turbines, and HVAC systems using thermodynamic property tables and software.

milestones.label: Master fluid mechanics
milestones.description: Fluid statics, viscous flow, pipe systems, dimensional analysis, and introduction to CFD. Students design fluid systems and analyze flow using computational tools.

milestones.label: Participate in Formula SAE or Baja SAE team
milestones.description: Join NC A&T's Formula SAE or Baja SAE team, designing and building a race car. Apply thermodynamics, dynamics, and manufacturing skills in a competitive, team-based engineering project.

milestones.label: Complete summer mechanical engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a manufacturing company, automotive OEM, aerospace firm, or energy company. Apply mechanical design and analysis skills professionally.

milestones.label: Study machine design and mechanisms
milestones.description: Design of gears, bearings, shafts, springs, fasteners, and welded joints using ASME standards. Students complete a comprehensive machine design project including FEA analysis.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, prepare for FE exam, and launch ME career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long mechanical engineering design project with an industry sponsor. Teams design, analyze, fabricate, test, and present a working mechanical system.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and professional licensure
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES FE Mechanical exam through review courses and practice exams. Begin the path toward PE licensure.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and ASME chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in ME coursework, lead ASME chapter activities, and organize design workshops, plant tours, and career panels.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, design portfolio, CAD models, FEA results, FE exam status, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Mechanical Engineering Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or FE exam results.
